Players Committee card image of [[Corporal Pao]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Power +1 while with Melshi or Sefla. During battle, may add X (limit 3) to a just drawn battle destiny, where X = number of your spies out of play. If just lost from a site, may draw cards from Reserve Deck until you have up to six cards in hand.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/corporalpao.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/corporalpao.png] as of commit c241f88 “vset14” (18 March 2021).
